notes: Honest null: the awarding body's own domain refuses every request, so no logo URL can be probed and rule 4 cannot be satisfied for any candidate. www.ulisboa.pt sits behind a Fortinet ADC/ADC-waf that returns HTTP 403 for every path, to browser and non-browser clients alike, with an empty error body. Evidence, all attempts on 2026-10-04: webfetch of https://www.ulisboa.pt/en returned 'non 2xx status code (403)'; Invoke-WebRequest on https://www.ulisboa.pt/en and https://www.ulisboa.pt/ both returned '403 Forbidden', and the bare https://ulisboa.pt/ closed the connection; Playwright navigation to https://www.ulisboa.pt/en and to the record's own official_source_url https://www.ulisboa.pt/en/study/fees-and-scholarships returned a document response of 403 whose entire body is a 312-character wrapper containing only an iframe pointing at /fortiadc_error_page/403.html, which is why the page scans as empty with no title, no images and no icon links. Direct asset probes outside the page context all returned '403 text/html 309B' with no image content type: /favicon.ico, /apple-touch-icon.png, /assets/images/logo.svg, /static/images/logo.svg, /sites/default/files/logo.png, /img/logo.svg and /images/logo.png. Per brief section 2.4 I did fall back to the browser where webfetch was blocked, and the browser is blocked too, so this is a hard wall rather than a scraper-detection issue I could route around. I deliberately did not substitute a logo from any other source: the University of Lisbon's Portuguese-, Lisbon- and Rectory-side marks on third-party or mirror hosts are barred by rules 1 and 6, and reconstructing an asset URL would breach rule 5. This is a null about verifiability, not a claim that the university has no logo - the University of Lisbon certainly publishes one, it simply cannot be probed from here. RECOMMENDATION FOR THE COORDINATOR: this host is worth retrying from a network without the Fortinet block, or the record's image should be resolved by a human from a browser session on a normal residential IP. Also note for the data side: the record's stored official_source_url https://www.ulisboa.pt/en/study/fees-and-scholarships could not be confirmed as live for the same reason, so its existence is unverified rather than disproven.
